blocked.substitution_policy: Do not reconstruct, imitate, or claim access to the official assignments; use clearly labeled manager-authored work instead.

retrieval_policy.kickoff_dependency: The kickoff is self-contained and does not require any linked or blocked material.
future_public_retrieval: A later authorized job may retrieve only openly accessible resources from the cataloged URLs.
Record the exact URL, retrieval time, content digest, license or terms when known, and validation result.
Classify each retrieved item by role and offering before proposing new units.
A link collection, repository, or recording playlist must not be promoted automatically to an official unit or syllabus position.
restricted_content: Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, enrollment controls, robots restrictions, or other access controls.
Do not fetch or expose the non-open-source assignments.
Keep unavailable items blocked until lawful public access and provenance can be established.
retrieval_policy.failure_handling: Preserve LINKED_UNVERIFIED or blocked status when retrieval or classification cannot be completed; never infer availability from a catalog link alone.
